| Fiscal quarter | Operating income |
|---|---|
| Q1 (December 2024) | $42.832B |
| Q2 | $29.589B |
| Q3 | $28.202B |
| Q4 | $32.427B |

These add up to about $133.05B for the year, and $133.05B ÷ 4 ≈ $33.26B.
